note: Metronome v2, UA cohort: synchronized re-download loop against the seven pre-existing UA listings' 0.7.3 reuploads, onset 2026-09-06 (the eu-maps 0.7.3 release day), ~6.8/day per listing in fixed slots regardless of listing popularity (zaporizhzhia/kryvyi-rih at 1.0-1.1/day organic run the same weekly totals as kharkiv/lviv/odesa at ~2/day; kyiv = the same uniform floor plus its own ~6/day organic, matching its v0.1.0-era rate). The v0.2.0 traffic is modeled as a loop-inflated ADOPTION release: legitimate traffic = organic update adoption of the 07-08 install base plus new organic demand, estimated from three clean yukina pack-refresh adoption curves (brno 0.4.1, asahikawa 0.2.2, bydgoszcz-torun 0.5.0 - max-fraction pooling errs toward attributing less). The retired 0.1.0 versions carry no incident-window traffic (assets retired at the reupload) and are not targeted; the spec is adoption-targets-only. Loop NOT yet extinguished (healthy live listings - no deprecation kill available); incident_end stays open and re-applies accrue until the client dies or is blocked.
